[[File:Vyrewatch chathead.png|left]]
The '''Vyrewatch''' are the [[vampyre|vampyric]] vanguard responsible for enforcing the racial policy of [[Morytania]] and suppress any resistance to the [[House Drakan|Drakan]] overlords. 

Vyrewatch in [[Meiyerditch]] are not aggressive but can initiate "aggression" if a player is near them. This aggression can be lowered by wearing pieces of the [[vyrewatch outfit]], with each piece adding a 20% chance to avoid detection. If a vyrewatch takes an interest in the player and manages to get next to them, the vyre will drop down and speak to the player, demanding a blood tithe. The player has one of four options; letting them take a tithe, which deals light damage, being sent to the [[Meiyerditch mine|mines]], fight them or attempt to distract them. If the distract fails, the vyre will tithe the player, the same as the first option.

In addition to the flying variety, there is a group of grounded, level 105 Vyrewatch north of [[Crombwick Manor]] in [[Slepe]]. This variant is different in that they act like normal monsters would and attack significantly faster than the flying variant.

Wearing a set of [[Vyre noble clothing]] will make all vyrewatch tolerant of the player. This requirement is lifted after the third fight with [[Lowerniel Drakan]] in [[The Blood Moon Rises]], where all vyrewatch will become tolerant of the player.

Vyrewatch are considered [[Vampyre (attribute)|tier 3 vampyres]], meaning that they will only take damage from corresponding sources, such as the [[Ivandis flail]], [[blisterwood weaponry]], [[hallowed flail]] and [[sunspear]]. [[Efaritay's aid]] will not allow normal weapons to damage vyrewatch, but the +15% accuracy and damage bonus will still apply.

==Success chance==
The chance of successfully distracting a vyrewatch after being halted for a blood tithe scales with the player's Thieving level.{{CiteTwitter|author=JagexAsh|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1542878494119657478|date=1 July 2022|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/100703|archivedate=7 December 2022|quote=[(...) If time permits could you shed some light on the success rate of distracting Vyrewatch? I just did Darkness of Hallowvale on a lower level alt and had a terrible time, even with the Vyre outfit 😓] The skill-based roll is 0% at level 1 Thieving, 99% at level 99. In addition to passing that, the game needs to be able to find a tile for you to run towards, about 4 tiles away.}} In addition, a valid game square must be found about four squares away for the player to escape to in order for a vyrewatch to be successfully distracted.

==Slayer==
In order to receive a Slayer task for [[Vyre]]s, a player must have at least 38 Slayer.

When killing Vyrewatch for Vampyre Slayer tasks, players are encouraged to complete the task in [[Slepe]]. This is recommended only to players that have completed [[A Taste of Hope]].

Players utilizing a general prayer armour setup can use [[drakan's medallion]] to teleport to [[Ver Sinhaza]] for banking and run north to Slepe where they can use an Altar of Zamorak to restore prayer points on their way to slaying Vyrewatch immediately north of the [[Crombwick Manor]]. An empty inventory with a single [[combat potion]] can be used to maximise a player's collection of [[vampyre dust]] and [[runite bar]]s, while praying [[Protect from Melee]] at this location.

Players that have done the [[Sins of the Father]] quest on the other hand can slay [[Vyrewatch Sentinel]]s in Darkmeyer, which have a more lucrative drop table and are very close to an Altar.
